_comment: Connection details for the `devops` agent. Copy to .claude/deploy-config.json and fill in.
THIS FILE IS GITIGNORED. Never commit it, never paste its contents into a chat or an issue.
Store PATHS and NAMES here — never a password, key material, or a token.
Secrets themselves belong on the target host or in a secret manager.

target._note: identityFile is a PATH to a key. Never inline the key itself.

deploy.script: <path to the deploy script on the target, or the command used locally>
deploy.workingDir: <path to the checkout on the target>

health.url: <https://host/health — the endpoint that proves it actually works>
health._note: A started process is not a working service. If the app has a worker/queue, add its check here too — a green web process with a dead worker is a silently broken deploy.

backup.command: <the command that backs up the database>
backup._note: Required before any schema or data mutation. Confirm the backup exists before proceeding.

rollback.command: <the move that reverts a bad deploy>

neverOverwrite: <tables/collections a data sync must never touch — billing, credentials, subscriptions>
secretsLocation: <where the real secrets live on the target — a path or a manager name, NOT the values>
